interventions.detail: Python 2.7 unavailable on Ubuntu 24.04/uv; installed via micromamba conda-forge env
tensorflow==1.15.0 (1.15.5 has no cp27mu wheel), numpy==1.16.6, protobuf==3.17.3, h5py==2.10.0
grpcio==1.39.0 with --prefer-binary; newer grpcio source build fails on py2.7
README gives no install steps for Python/TensorFlow; created env manually
symlinked /usr/bin/python to py27 interpreter because tfrecord.py shebang is #!/usr/bin/python
